name: elasticsearch
description: This Elasticsearch docker version is built from the official Elasticsearch docker with minimal changes tailoring it for easier use on Unraid and for the purpose for use with Nextcloud. Elasticsearch with instructions for installation on Unraid and then Nextcloud. Elasticsearch version is 7.10.2 Directions below MUST be used in order to get Elasticsearch 5 and above working correctly. Directions: 1. see [a href="https://github.com/d8sychain/docker-elasticsearch/blob/master/README.md"]README.md[/a]
